# Mono/Poly — the field of notations

The whole field of notations implied by the symbolon directory works: many notations, one field. Mono/Poly is grounded as the Becoming harmonic of the processual pass (process §4′: "Mono-Poly = Becoming — the /-side pair… the Mono going Poly… the Poly going Mono") and as the essay's sustained whole/many relation — the one relational whole differentiating through many real expressions, neither a giant entity nor a heap of atoms ([[section-rooms/arguments/A12-Mono-Poly-One-All-Whole-Many.md|A12]]; `C26 — Monoisation / Counter-Generation` as the failure mechanism; `C54 — Commons / Non-Monopoly` as the shared-field face).

This folder is where the notations being defined across the matheme — binary, slash-forms, ratios, determinations, lens IDs, CF grammar — are held together as one countable field: which notations the system implies, how each reduces or expands, where two notations say one thing.

## Structure

- **[mono](mono.md)** — the one field: what every notation in the system is a notation *of* — the 0/1 and its expressions; the equation as the single subject carried by all four files.
- **[poly](poly.md)** — the many notations: the inventory as plurality — each sign's office, each formalism's contact point, each register's dialect, held without collapse into one preferred encoding.
- **[translations](translations.md)** — the mapped correspondences and their proof boundaries: which reductions are derivations, which are constructions, which are named cross-register recognitions (the record form's three separated claims, applied notation-to-notation).

Feeds the [[symbolon/matheme/dia-syn/README.md|Dia/Syn]] logics (the operations run between notations) and returns to the [[symbolon/matheme/README.md|matheme spine]] at the Becoming position.
